_comment: Copy to config/services.json and fill in. Until that file exists the
Public goods button does not appear and the page says nothing is
published — an endpoint we do not run must never be listed as one we do.
Every field is optional. Anything left out is simply not rendered, so
start with what is ready and add the rest later.
netInfoRpc is NOT shown on the page. It is read server-side to list live
peers, so it can be an internal address that is not publicly reachable.
